title: Diagonal counit with independent derived localizations
statement: Let X,S be Noetherian schemes and f:X→S flat and proper. Choose independent derived localizations on X,S,P=X×_S X. Let R be a functor on the quasi-coherent derived subcategories equipped with the given comparison to Rf*, and a its specified right adjoint. Let c be the specified right adjoint of the restriction of RDelta*, using a given quasi-coherent preservation witness. Let O be a quasi-coherent object isomorphic to O_S[0]. Then Lpr_1* a(O), defined using [def-pc-derived-pullback-across-universes], has quasi-coherent cohomology; for its corresponding full-subcategory object K there is an isomorphism c(K) ≅ O_X[0] in D(X). Perfection of the diagonal is not assumed. The adjoints are the supplied ones.

proof.text: Compare each specified localization with its standard localization using schemeDerivedStandardEquivalence. Precompose with Qh and use Localization.compUniqFunctor and homologyFunctorFactorsh to identify the homology functors. Full faithfulness of precomposition with Qh lifts the identification. Therefore the equivalence preserves and reflects quasi-coherent cohomology, and congrFullSubcategory restricts it to D_QCoh. The same comparison evaluated on the single homotopy complex identifies degree-zero single objects. Quasi-coherent singles are proved from their degree-zero homology and the vanishing of all other homology.

For any scheme morphism, use derivedModuleDirectImageFactorization in both localization choices. Both factorizations use the same functorial K-injective resolution and the same termwise module direct image. The localization comparison commutes with Q, obtained by composing quotientCompQhIso with compUniqFunctor. Consequently the resolved functors commute with the target comparison. Full faithfulness of precomposition with Q lifts these isomorphisms to a comparison of derived direct images. Apply this to f and its diagonal.

The first projection of P=X times_S X is proper by base change. LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian and QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace make P Noetherian. In the standard localization obtain quasi-coherent preservation witnesses for f and the diagonal from noetherian_schemeDerivedDirectImage_has_rightAdjoint. Obtain first-projection pullback preservation from derivedPullback_tensor_preserve_QCoh.

Lift the given comparison R to the standard D_QCoh subcategories using full faithfulness of their inclusions and the direct-image comparisons. Conjugate the given adjunctions by the restricted equivalences, and transfer their left adjoints along these lifted isomorphisms. Apply diagonal_counit_identity to the canonical standard structure single objects, the transported a and c, and these transported adjunctions.

Map hO through the localization equivalence and lift it to D_QCoh. The unit of the restricted equivalence then identifies transported a applied to the standard structure object with the comparison of a(O). Construct hK as the property of the inverse-equivalence image of the standard quasi-coherent pullback object; its ambient object is definitionally derivedPullbackAcrossUniverses applied to a(O). The counit identifies the comparison of K with the standard pullback. Apply transported c to these isomorphisms and compose with the inverse of the standard diagonal counit identity. Full faithfulness of the ambient equivalence transports the resulting isomorphism back, using standard_single to identify its target with the specified structure single on X.
